parameters.label: The tag's words.
parameters.secondary: A second line under the label (the medium size only).
parameters.avatar: Places an avatar alongside the tag’s label.
parameters.size: Selects the size of the component.
parameters.shape: Chooses the outline of the component.
parameters.onDeleted: Runs when the reader removes the tag.
parameters.enabled: False draws the disabled face (a dismissible tag goes inert).
parameters.deleteLabel: Names the remove action for assistive technology.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
